title: Notification regarding Special Division Bench of Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh & Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 22-07-2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
and Hon'ble' Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 22-07-2026 at 12:00 noon.

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 21;t July, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that there will be a Special Division Bench of Hon'ble Mr. Justice A, Birnol Singh
and Hon'ble' Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma on 22-07-2026 at 12:00 noon.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. AIIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ /rg 67 .- 99
12
